evidence.observation: 3.018 Torr at growth start, matching the ~3.0 Torr seen throughout the ramp
3.509 Torr, a steady rise of about 0.5 Torr over 12 min
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the rise is not caused by extra inflow
Thermocouple on the 750 °C setpoint; heater power steady at ~45%
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed; growth atmosphere cannot be verified
